definitions.BearerSecurity.description: "Note: The \"Bearer \" prefix is automatically added to the Authorization header. You only need to provide your access token in the Value field.\n\nExample: `12345abcdef`"
definitions.OauthSecurity.description: "A bearer token provided by the Avalara Identity server."
definitions.UserSecurity.description: "Basic authentication supports either Username/Password or AccountId/LicenseKey, using Base64 encoding."
